mapper.select: select distinct category_title from watcha_rank where save_date = (select MAX(save_date) from watcha_rank)

select m.period, m.country, w.*, r.media_rank from media m, watcha w, watcha_rank r where r.category_title = #{categoryTitle} and r.media_id = w.media_id and m.media_id = w.media_id and r.save_date = (select MAX(save_date) from watcha_rank) order by r.media_rank

select *, ( select count(*) from media_comment b where b.media_id = a.media_id ) as total_comment_count, ( select round(sum(assess_rate) / count(*), 1) from media_comment b where b.media_id = a.media_id ) as avg_point, ( select assess_rate from media_comment b where b.media_id = a.media_id and b.writer = #{emailId} ) as assess_rate from media a where media_id = #{media_id}

select w.img_src, r.* from watcha w left join watcha_rank r on r.media_id = w.media_id and r.save_date = (select MAX(save_date) from watcha_rank) where w.media_id = #{media_id} order by r.media_rank asc limit 1

select m.*, w.img_src from media m left join watcha w on m.media_id = w.media_id where 1=1
and m.genre like concat('%', #{genre}, '%')
and m.media_div = #{mediaDiv} order by m.update_date desc, m.save_date desc, m.rank, m.open_date desc
select *, count(*) as total from media_comment where media_id = #{media_id}
mapper.insert: insert into media_comment ( media_id, writer, content, assess_rate, save_date ) values ( #{media_id}, #{writer}, #{content}, #{assess_rate}, date_format(now(), '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') )
